entities.summary: Giuseppe Dossetti was an Italian jurist, politician, theologian and Catholic priest. A prominent anti-fascist and Resistance fighter, Dossetti served as Vice-Secretary of the Christian Democracy, and as a member of the Italian Constituent Assembly from 1946 to 1948 and the Italian Chamber of Deputies from 1948 to 1952. Around him a movement emerged, known as "Dossettismo", which has continued to influence the Italian political, social, religious and cultural landscape.
